text:
alex: Heads-up: launching a Rate Tier Conversion (RTC) and Graceband process next week to smooth customers moving between rate tiers. Effective: 2026-05-07 00:00 UTC. This affects metering, invoice CSV, and the billing API.

alex: TL;DR — we’re introducing a 72h smoothing window so customers that cross thresholds briefly aren’t immediately bumped into a higher rate tier. We’ll also auto-apply one-time migration credits for customers that upgrade/downgrade within a 30-day migration window.

jordan: Finance note — credits will be applied automatically and visible as a line item called "RTC-migration-credit" on invoices. Cap for auto credits: $5,000 per account. Retro adjustments limited to 60 days.

maya: Support ops: please prep canned replies. Key customer Qs: "Will I get charged twice?" -> answer: "No, the smoothing window avoids transient escalations; any billing adjustment will appear as a single credit line within 1 billing cycle."

sam: Engineering heads-up: API header change for metering versioning. New header X-Redwood-Meter-Version: 2.0 will be accepted starting 2026-05-07; old header supported for 90 days then deprecated. Sample response snippet below for teams that read raw metrics: 

```
# New CSV columns (invoice export v2):
account_id,period_start,period_end,total_tokens,billed_tokens,rate_tier,rtc_credit_line,rtc_credit_amount
```

sam: Also adding a /v2/metering endpoint that returns smoothing windows used per-account. We'll land a small migration guide in docs next sprint.

claire: Console/UX: we'll show a banner for impacted customers for 14 days before the cutover and add a tooltip on the quota page explaining the 72h graceband. UX copy draft: "Transient spikes? We wait 72 hours before switching rate tiers to reduce noisy escalations."

maya: Q for finance/eng — what happens with Dedicated reserved customers? Are they exempt?

jordan: Reserved/Dedicated customers are exempt from automatic tier moves; they keep contract rates but we will show an informational advisory in billing UI for visibility. If they opt into RTC smoothing, support can toggle it for their account.

alex: Action items: 
- @jordan: publish credit rules doc + sample invoice line.
- @sam: publish API header/deprecation notes + sample CSV.
- @maya: prepare support playbook + canned replies.
- @claire: banner + tooltip copy ready by 2026-05-04.
- @ops-bot: create tracking ticket and flag on launch board.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-RTC-2026 and scheduled for the May 7 cutover. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-RTC-2026 :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks — will run a small internal dry-run with support on Friday to rehearse responses.

alex: One more note: we'll publish an FAQ in the customer docs and a short email template for account execs to send to top 50 customers. If anyone wants to review the FAQ draft ping me.

jordan: I'll coordinate the customer email list and the executive template.

sam: I'll open the PR for /v2/metering and drop the migration guide into docs repo by EOD Thursday.

claire: UX will put the banner copy into staging tomorrow.

alex: Thanks all — ping here for any blockers. :thumbsup:
